name: Seerr Notifications
description: Deliver Seerr request and issue notifications over WhatsApp, formatted per recipient.
author: gunslingerkw

seerrUrl.title: Seerr URL
seerrUrl.description: Required. Base URL of your Seerr server, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5055.

seerrApiKey.title: Seerr API key
seerrApiKey.description: Required. Used to read the user list and to fill notifications out with media detail.

requireMappedUser.title: Require a mapped user
requireMappedUser.description: On = an event resolving to no recipient is recorded as a dead letter instead of being dropped quietly.

users.title: Recipient mappings
users.description: One entry per notified Seerr account. Managed from the Recipients tab; identity and admin status come from the cached roster, and an account that is not in Seerr cannot be added here.

sendPoster.title: Send poster image
sendPoster.description: Attach the poster to Now Available / Request Submitted notifications.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Log each delivery: event type, resolved recipient count, masked chat ids and send outcomes. Never logs message bodies.

seerrRoster.title: Seerr roster (cached)
seerrRoster.description: Seerr accounts cached by refresh-roster.mjs so the config editor can list them. Not edited by hand — the editor has no network of its own.

rosterRefreshRequestedAt.title: Roster refresh token
rosterRefreshRequestedAt.description: Stamped by the Refresh from Seerr button. Changing it is what asks the plugin to refetch the roster; it is not edited by hand.

setup.title: Setup state (plugin-written)
setup.description: Ingress instances, the last generated ingress secret and the update check, written by the plugin for the Setup tab. Not edited by hand.

setupRequestedAt.title: Setup action token
setupRequestedAt.description: Stamped by the Setup tab buttons as "<action>|<arg>|<timestamp>", and cleared by the plugin once the action has run. Not edited by hand.

updateCheckEnabled.title: Check GitHub for new releases
updateCheckEnabled.description: Once a day, ask github.com whether a newer release of this plugin exists, and show a banner if so. Nothing is downloaded or installed. Off = no outbound request is ever made.

routing.title: Per-event routing
routing.description: Who receives each Seerr event, and whether admins get the Admin Info block. Managed from the Who gets what tab; unset events fall back to the plugin defaults.
